exported_target.text: The dwelling of the sons of Israel, who lived in Egypt[a], was four hundred thirty years.

footnotes.text: POB provisionally retains the Masoretic wording. The Samaritan Hebrew control includes their fathers and places Canaan before Egypt; the Rahlfs Greek edition places Egypt before Canaan without the fathers. Other Greek witnesses include the fathers; the Cambridge apparatus reports this addition after Canaan in Alexandrinus. It also reports 435 years in Vaticanus's first hand and 430 after correction, with uncertainty about the corrector's identity. In the published 4Q14 transcription, partly preserved Egypt is followed directly by the duration, excluding Canaan after Egypt there; the missing beginning cannot exclude Canaan before Egypt or the fathers. In 2Q2 the geographical phrase is supplied in a gap. These fragments do not establish the entire Egypt-only form, and the earliest wording remains uncertain.
